body.text: Goals: Explain team dynamics. Ice Cube — the pen, the narrator, the political critic. Wrote MOST of the early lyrics. Dr. Dre — the producer, the architect, the engineer. DJ Yella — producer, engineer, Dre collaborator. Teach your son: Great movements require many talents.

finalProject.prompt: Explain how N.W.A used truth-telling, political critique, and West Coast production to reshape hip-hop. Compare ONE early track (‘Straight Outta Compton’ or ‘Gangsta Gangsta’) with ONE socially focused track (‘F*** Tha Police’ or ‘Express Yourself’). Identify TWO modern artists whose work clearly traces back to N.W.A’s influence.
